summary: @onereach/billing-shared preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's declared `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a sibling file `math_init.js` located at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-CJS bundle bearing obfuscator.io fingerprints (shuffled string/number arrays, rotation function performing repeated push/shift, and an indirected string decoder). The file is not enumerated in `package.json` `files` and is unrelated to the declared library surface (`main=dist/cjs/index.js`), which advertises a billing/types/utilities library. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape — fetching a second language runtime at install specifically to execute an undeclared, obfuscated sibling bundle bypasses scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code, and has no relationship to the package's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
